name: ux-design
description: Two commands: /ux-design designs one item with UI before the build (design spec, mockups of each state, and a prototype for a test with users), and /ux-review checks the built screens against the design. A UX designer agent does the work, with a source for each design decision. Skills for patterns, visual craft, states, Claude Design, Figma, OpenPencil, brand files and DTCG tokens, and WCAG 2.2 accessibility. Output in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English or Begrijpelijk Nederlands (B1).
